name: VOLT-FORGE proposed six-minute electrical case
cell_identity_evidence: Dataset M1 nominal position order; actual sensor/hardware mapping remains an author question.
parameter_classification: Frozen fitted R0/R1/tau and calibration-rest reference; capacity derived from C/20 current integration. Not independent measurements of physical circuit elements or equilibrium OCV.
initial_state_evidence: Unverified preparation assumption after rest; SOC is relative to each fitted reference. No measured module initializer.
rail_evidence: Proposed segment values, including whatever contact resistance the segment represents; not measured hardware. No extra terminal leads are modeled.
load_classification: Proposed application requirement; discharge positive. Not an established competition requirement.

temperature.evidence: Nominal 23 C single-cell characterization; recorded surface temperature varied. V2 primary assessment subset 22-28 C. Module temperature history is unmeasured.
